title: Xi'an beats Beijing for first-timers: 13 dynasties | China Travel Expert
description:
Xi'an beats Beijing for a first China trip — and it's not close. Walk with me and tell me I'm wrong.

Xi'an (ancient Chang'an) has roughly 3,100 years of history and served as the capital of 13 officially recognized dynasties, from the Western Zhou to the Tang. It's one of China's Four Great Ancient Capitals, and most of the old city is walkable on foot — you step off the train into history instead of a modern skyline. Beijing is incredible, but for a first-timer who wants depth in a compact, walkable centre, Xi'an is my pick.

🧭 Expert Tip: Base yourself inside or just outside Xi'an's old walled city — you can cover the core on foot, and the high-speed train links Beijing in about 4.5–6 hours if you want both.

第一次来中国，西安还是北京？十三朝古都，一座能走着逛完的老城。
